[b][color=#00ffff]Island Gatherers[/color][/b]
[spoiler]
[b]" [b]Island Gatherers[/b] is a mod for Stardew Valley that adds a way for Parrots to harvest crops from Ginger Island.

The mod adds a new purchasable item called the Parrot Pot, which can be purchased from the Island Trader at Ginger Island.

This item can only be placed on the Island Farm area.

Once placed, the Parrots will appear each morning and immediately harvest all available crops, forage products and fruit trees within the area. Right clicking the Parrot Pot will open up a chest-like inventory, allowing you to extract the harvested items.

[b]Install[/b]
1. Install the latest version of SMAPI.
2. Install all the dependencies.
3. Install this mod.
4. The IslandGatherersAutomate is optional unless you're using the Automate mod.
5. Run the game using SMAPI.

[b]Unlocking the Parrot Pot[/b]
To unlock the Parrot Pot, you must finish repairing the Ginger Island farm house.
[b]
Purchasing the Parrot Pot[/b]
The Parrot Pot requires the following ingredients:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Cinder Shards x50[/b][/*]
[/list][b]
Using the Parrot Pot
Once per morning, the Parrots will search the surrounding area. The Parrots will gather crops, forage products and fruit trees that are ready for harvesting.

If the Parrots successfully harvested anything, you will get a message in the morning letting you know. The Parrot Pot will also have an updated sprite, showing that it contains items.

Right clicking the Parrot Pot will open up a chest-like inventory, allowing you to extract the harvested items.

Note that if the Parrot Pot gets full, the Parrots will eat any excess products they gather! This can disabled within the config if you so wish.

Replanting
While harvesting the Parrots will replant any non-renewing crops, so long as the Parrot Pot contains the matching seeds.

e.g. If the Parrots harvest a parsnip, they will look inside the Parrot Pot for a parsnip seed. If there is at least one, they will use it to replant the harvested parsnip.

If you'd like to disable this behavior, set DoParrotsSowSeedsAfterHarvest in the config.json to false or use GMCM"[/b][/spoiler]

[color=#00ff00][b]Greenhouse Gatherers[/b][/color]
[spoiler][b][color=#00ff00]" [b]Greenhouse Gatherers[/b] is a mod for Stardew Valley that adds a way for Junimos to harvest crops inside buildings.

The mod adds a new craftable item called the [b]Harvest Statue[/b], which is given by mail after unlocking the Junimo Huts from the Wizard. This statue can only be placed indoors and only one can be placed per building.

Once placed inside, the Junimos will appear each morning and immediately harvest all available crops, forage products and fruit trees within the building. Right clicking the Harvest Statue will open up a chest-like inventory, allowing you to extract the harvested items.

[b]NOTE: This mod has only been tested for vanilla and certain modded buildings. See the Compatibility section for a full list of validated mods.[/b]

[b]Install[/b]
1. Install the latest ve[/color]rsion of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
2. Install all the dependencies.
3. Install this mod.
4. [b]PLEASE NOTE:[/b] The GreenhouseGatherersAutomate folder is not required unless you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate [/url]installed.
5. Run the game using SMAPI.

[b]Unlocking the Harvest Statue[/b]
To unlock the Harvest Statue, you must finish the Goblin Problem Quest. The day after completing the quest, you will be sent the recipe by the Wizard.

Alternatively, you can set the [b]ForceRecipeUnlock [/b]config option to [b]true[/b], which will cause the recipe to appear in your mailbox.

[b]Crafting the Harvest Statue[/b]
The Harvest Statue requires the following ingredients:
[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Prismatic Shard x1[/b][/*]
[*][b]Stone x350[/b][/*]
[*][b]Starfruit x150[/b][/*]
[/list][b]
The recipe can be changed to your preference by editing the big-craftable.json file under the ...\GreenhouseGatherers\GreenhouseGatherers\assets\HarvestStatue\BigCraftables\Harvest Statue folder.

Using the Harvest Statue
Once per morning, the Junimos will search each building that a Harvest Statue is located in. The Junimos will gather crops, forage products and fruit trees that are ready for harvesting nearby.

If the Junimos successfully harvested anything, you will get a message in the morning letting you know (the message will tell you what building they harvested from). The Harvest Statue will also have an updated sprite, showing that it contains items.

Right clicking the Harvest Statue will open up a chest-like inventory, allowing you to extract the harvested items.

Note that if the Harvest Statue gets full, the Junimos will eat any excess products they gather! This can disabled within the config if you so wish.

Replanting
While harvesting the Junimos will replant any non-renewing crops, so long as the Harvest Statue contains the matching seeds.
e.g. If the Junimos harvest a parsnip, they will look inside the Harvest Statue for a parsnip seed. If there is at least one, they will
use it to replant the harvested parsnip.

If you'd like to disable this behavior, set DoJunimosSowSeedsAfterHarvest in the config.json to false"[/b][/spoiler]
